name: MultiForm Anti-Spam Image CAPTCHA
author: Plugin Brewery

sections.description:
MultiForm Anti-Spam Image CAPTCHA adds a fast, accessible icon challenge to the most popular free form builders. Visitors simply pick the requested icon while bots are blocked by hashed answers, honeypots, and server-side validation that expires stale keys automatically.

The free version focuses on the essentials so you can drop a CAPTCHA into Contact Form 7, WPForms, or Formidable Forms in seconds. Every other integration, style option, and advanced security toggle lives in the Pro version.

Why choose MultiForm Anti-Spam Image CAPTCHA

  • Unique server-side keys mean the correct icon can’t be scraped from the markup.
  • Native integrations for CF7, WPForms, and Formidable—no DIY HTML fragments or template edits.
  • No reliance on third-party services, reCAPTCHA quotas, or external JavaScript widgets.

Free Features

  • Contact Form 7 shortcode/tag button
  • WPForms drag-and-drop field
  • Formidable Forms shortcode support
  • Built-in honeypot field
  • Keyboard-friendly radio buttons with clear text instructions
  • Server-side validation with daily cleanup

Upgrade to MultiForm Anti-Spam Image CAPTCHA Pro for:

  • Gravity Forms, Elementor Pro Forms, WooCommerce, WordPress login/registration/password, and native comments
  • GDPR + ADA/WCAG enhancements and audio support
  • Reverse honeypot, submission speed checks, AJAX refresh, and icon randomization
  • Icon packs: upload SVGs or tap into Font Awesome
  • Full stylistic control (colors, sizes, borders, messaging, layout)

How the free version works

  1. Add the CAPTCHA to a supported form builder (instructions below).
  2. The form outputs a random icon challenge with text instructions.
  3. When the form submits we verify the answer, honeypot, and timing server-side.

Step-by-step instructions

Contact Form 7

  1. Go to Contact → Contact Forms and edit your form.
  2. Click the MultiForm Anti-Spam Image CAPTCHA tag button or manually insert [pbmfasic].
  3. Save the form and place it on a page/post as usual. The CAPTCHA renders automatically on the front end.

WPForms

  1. Edit your form in WPForms → All Forms.
  2. In the Standard Fields panel drag the MultiForm Anti-Spam Image CAPTCHA field into your form (drop it above the submit button for the best UX).
  3. Save the form. No additional configuration is required; the CAPTCHA appears everywhere that form is used.

Formidable Forms

  1. Edit your Formidable form and add an HTML field where you want the CAPTCHA to appear.
  2. Inside that HTML field paste the shortcode [pbmfasic].
  3. Save the form and publish it—Formidable renders the CAPTCHA wherever that HTML field appears.

Support

Need more integrations or customization? Visit https://pluginbrewery.com/wordpress-plugins/multiform-anti-spam-image-captcha-pro/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/ and activate it.
  2. Go to Settings → MultiForm Anti-Spam Image CAPTCHA to view usage instructions and the Pro feature list.
  3. Add the CAPTCHA to your forms:
    • Contact Form 7: insert [pbmfasic] (or use the tag button).
    • WPForms: drag the MultiForm Anti-Spam Image CAPTCHA field into your form.
    • Formidable Forms: drop an HTML field and place [pbmfasic] inside it.
sections.faq:
Which forms are supported for free?

Contact Form 7, WPForms, and Formidable Forms. Every other integration (Gravity Forms, Elementor Pro, WooCommerce, WordPress login/comments, etc.) is part of MultiForm Anti-Spam Image CAPTCHA Pro.

Can I customize the icons, colors, or messages?

Not in the free version. All customization controls—including icon selection, colors, layout, AJAX toggles, and error text—are unlocked in Pro.

Is the CAPTCHA accessible?

Yes. The challenge uses keyboard-friendly radio buttons, clear on-page instructions, and ARIA labels. Audio prompts and deeper accessibility tuning are part of the Pro version.

Does it work with caching plugins and CDNs?

Yes. Validation runs server-side and submission keys expire automatically, so cached pages continue to work normally.

Can I use it alongside reCAPTCHA or other spam blockers?

Absolutely. MultiForm Anti-Spam Image CAPTCHA works independently and adds another validation layer alongside tools like reCAPTCHA or Akismet.

How is this different from “static answer” icon CAPTCHAs?

Every challenge generates a unique key, hashes the correct icon with your site salt, and stores it in the database. Bots can’t scrape the answer from the markup, and stale keys are purged daily to prevent replay attacks.
